cases.scenario: The user asks to scan changed ModernUO skills but supplies no repository path or comparison revision.
cases.must_preserve: do not infer the repository or base revision

cases.scenario: The scanner finds an uncovered packet area and the user has not approved a new skill.
cases.must_preserve: mark the candidate USER_DECISION_REQUIRED and do not create a skill

cases.scenario: A confirmed repository and base revision are available, with a direct changed-path match in a skill reference.
cases.must_verify: run the scanner and inspect the current repository anchor before proposing an edit

cases.scenario: Return a complete scan result for a confirmed repository comparison.
